funktionen.rueckgabe: TABLE(abschnitt_id uuid, dienstreise_id uuid, nummer text, datum date, ab_zeit text, von_name text, nach_name text)
funktionen.quelltext:
select a.id, r.id, trim(a.nummer), coalesce(a.ab_datum, r.datum), to_char(a.ab_zeit, 'HH24:MI'),
         a.von_name, coalesce(a.nach_name, '')
    from public.dienstreise_abschnitt a
    join public.dienstreise r on r.id = a.dienstreise_id
    left join public.dienstreise_live l on l.abschnitt_id = a.id
   where a.art in ('zug', 'sbahn')
     and coalesce(trim(a.nummer), '') <> ''
     and a.ab_zeit is not null
     and r.datum between (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date - 1 and (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date + 1
     and exists (select 1 from public.dienstreise_fahrer f
                  where f.dienstreise_id = r.id and lower(coalesce(f.status, '')) = 'accepted' and f.beendet is null)
     and now() >= ((coalesce(a.ab_datum, r.datum) + a.ab_zeit) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '90 minutes'
     and (a.an_zeit is null or now() <= (
           (coalesce(a.an_datum, a.ab_datum, r.datum)
             + coalesce(nullif(l.ankunft, '')::time, a.an_zeit)
             + case when coalesce(nullif(l.ankunft, '')::time, a.an_zeit) < a.ab_zeit then interval '1 day' else interval '0' end)
           at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') + interval '30 minutes');

funktionen.name: obd_stufe_befehl
funktionen.quelltext:
select 'setparam ' || string_agg(
           basis || ':' || w.periode || ';' || (basis + 2) || ':' || w.winkel || ';' || (basis + 1) || ':' || w.strecke,
           ';' order by basis)
  from (values
          ('sparsam', 60, 30, 0),
          ('mittel', 30, 15, 200),
          ('fein', 10, 10, 100)
       ) as w(stufe, periode, winkel, strecke)
  cross join unnest(array[10050, 10150, 10250]) as basis
  where w.stufe = p_stufe

funktionen.name: ortung_fenster
funktionen.rueckgabe: TABLE(von timestamp with time zone, bis timestamp with time zone, art text)
funktionen.quelltext:
with dienst as (
    select d.service_date as tag,
           case when lower(coalesce(d.status, '')) = 'accepted' then d.service_start_time
                else nullif(a.vorher->>'start', '')::time end as s,
           -- Dienstende (13.11.): das von der Dispo gesendete Ende gilt fuer die Ortung sofort, auch wenn
           -- der Fahrer die Aenderung noch nicht bestaetigt hat. Ab dieser Uhrzeit keine App-Standorte mehr.
           case when lower(coalesce(d.status, '')) = 'accepted' then d.service_end_time
                else coalesce(d.service_end_time, nullif(a.vorher->>'ende', '')::time) end as e,
           (lower(coalesce(d.status, '')) = 'accepted' or a.vorher is not null) as gilt
      from public.driver_service_requests d
      left join public.dienst_aenderung a on a.dienst_id = d.id
     where d.driver_id = p_fahrer
       and d.service_date between (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date - 1 and (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date + 2
       and lower(coalesce(d.status, '')) in ('accepted', 'pending')
  ), standby as (
    select s.datum as tag, coalesce(f.von_eigen, s.von) as s, coalesce(f.bis_eigen, s.bis) as e
      from public.standby_fahrer f join public.standby s on s.id = f.standby_id
     where f.driver_id = p_fahrer and lower(coalesce(f.status, '')) = 'accepted'
       and s.datum between (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date - 1 and (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date + 2
  ), reise as (
    -- Dienstreise (14.11.): angenommen und nicht beendet. Von 30 min vor Start bis Beenden, sonst bis
    -- 2 h nach der letzten Ankunft (Abschnitte), ohne Abschnitte 18 h nach Start.
    select ((r.datum + r.start_zeit) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') as ab,
           (select max(((coalesce(a.an_datum, a.ab_datum, r.datum) + a.an_zeit) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin'))
              from public.dienstreise_abschnitt a where a.dienstreise_id = r.id and a.an_zeit is not null) as an
      from public.dienstreise_fahrer f join public.dienstreise r on r.id = f.dienstreise_id
     where f.driver_id = p_fahrer and lower(coalesce(f.status, '')) = 'accepted' and f.beendet is null
       and r.datum between (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date - 1 and (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date + 2
  ), fahrt as (
    select ((j.ride_date + coalesce(j.etd, time '00:00')) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') as ab
      from public.jobs j
     where j.driver_id = p_fahrer
       and j.ride_date between (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date - 1 and (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date + 2
       and lower(coalesce(j.status, '')) not in ('done', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'storniert', 'refused')
  )
  -- Dienst ohne Ende (18.11.): offen bis die Dispo ein Ende sendet, nicht mehr nur bis Mitternacht.
  -- Vorher ging die Ortung um 00:00 aus, obwohl der Fahrer noch arbeitete.
  select ((tag + coalesce(s, time '00:00')) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin'),
         case when e is null then 'infinity'::timestamptz
              else ((tag + e + case when s is not null and e <= s then interval '1 day' else interval '0' end) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin') end,
         'dienst'
    from dienst where gilt and (s is not null or e is not null)
  union all
  select ((tag + s) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin'),
         ((tag + e + case when e <= s then interval '1 day' else interval '0' end) at time zone 'Europe/Berlin'),
         'standby'
    from standby where s is not null and e is not null
  union all
  select ab - interval '30 minutes', coalesce(an + interval '2 hours', ab + interval '18 hours'), 'dienstreise' from reise
  union all
  select ab - interval '60 minutes', ab + interval '12 hours', 'fahrt' from fahrt;

refresh_driver_activity_states
funktionen.quelltext:
begin
  with driver_jobs as (
    select
      j.driver_id as driver_id,
      j.id as job_id,
      j.ride_date,
      j.etd,
      lower(coalesce(j.status, '')) as job_status
    from public.jobs j
    where j.driver_id is not null

    union

    select
      ca.driver_id as driver_id,
      j.id as job_id,
      j.ride_date,
      j.etd,
      lower(coalesce(j.status, '')) as job_status
    from public.convoy_assignments ca
    join public.jobs j on j.id = ca.job_id
    where coalesce(lower(ca.response_status), 'pending') <> 'refused'
  ),
  computed as (
    select
      p.id as driver_id,
      case
        when exists (
          select 1
          from driver_jobs dj
          where dj.driver_id = p.id
            and dj.job_status in ('in_progress', 'started', 'unterwegs', 'active', 'ongoing', 'on_trip')
        ) then 'aktiv'

        when exists (
          select 1
          from driver_jobs dj
          where dj.driver_id = p.id
            and dj.job_status not in ('done', 'completed', 'arrived', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'refused', 'stoniert')
            and dj.job_status not in ('in_progress', 'started', 'unterwegs', 'active', 'ongoing', 'on_trip')
            and (dj.ride_date::timestamp + coalesce(dj.etd, '00:00'::time)) between now() and now() + interval '1 hour'
        ) then 'inaktiv'

        else 'frei'
      end as new_state
    from public.profiles p
    where coalesce(lower(p.role), '') not in ('dispo', 'dispatcher', 'admin', 'koordinator', 'coordinator')
      and coalesce(p.is_dispo, false) = false
  )
  update public.profiles p
  set
    driver_activity_state = c.new_state,
    driver_activity_state_updated_at = now()
  from computed c
  where p.id = c.driver_id
    and p.driver_activity_state is distinct from c.new_state;
end;

funktionen.name: trisar_vin_typ_lernen
funktionen.quelltext:
declare
  v_typ text := left(upper(coalesce(trim(new.vin), '')), 8);
  v_name text := trim(coalesce(new.brand_model, ''));
begin
  if v_typ !~ '^[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{8}$' or position(' ' in v_name) = 0 then
    return null;
  end if;
  insert into public.vin_typen (typ, brand_model, trim, fuel_type, seat_count, hsn, tsn, vehicle_id)
  values (v_typ, v_name, nullif(trim(new.trim), ''), nullif(trim(new.fuel_type), ''), new.seat_count,
          new.hsn, new.tsn, new.id)
  on conflict (typ) do update
    set brand_model = excluded.brand_model, trim = excluded.trim, fuel_type = excluded.fuel_type,
        seat_count = excluded.seat_count, hsn = coalesce(excluded.hsn, vin_typen.hsn),
        tsn = coalesce(excluded.tsn, vin_typen.tsn), vehicle_id = excluded.vehicle_id, gelernt_am = now();
  -- Schon angelegte Fahrzeuge desselben Typs, die nur die Marke haben, nachziehen.
  update public.vehicles v
     set brand_model = v_name,
         trim = coalesce(v.trim, nullif(trim(new.trim), '')),
         fuel_type = coalesce(nullif(trim(v.fuel_type), ''), nullif(trim(new.fuel_type), '')),
         seat_count = coalesce(v.seat_count, new.seat_count),
         hsn = coalesce(v.hsn, new.hsn),
         tsn = coalesce(v.tsn, new.tsn)
   where v.id <> new.id
     and left(upper(coalesce(v.vin, '')), 8) = v_typ
     and position(' ' in trim(coalesce(v.brand_model, ''))) = 0;
  return null;
end;

views.name: v_api_cost_live
views.definition:
SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS cost_last_1h_eur,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS cost_last_24h_eur,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= date_trunc('day'::text, now())) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS cost_today_eur,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS cost_last_7d_eur,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= date_trunc('month'::text, now())) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS cost_month_to_date_eur,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS requests_last_24h
   FROM api_usage_events;

views.name: v_api_cost_burn_rate
views.definition:
SELECT provider,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS burn_per_hour_eur,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS burn_last_24h_eur,
    round((COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric) / (24)::numeric), 4) AS projected_hourly_eur,
    round((COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) THEN estimated_cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric) * (30)::numeric), 2) AS projected_30d_eur
   FROM api_usage_events
  GROUP BY provider;

views.name: v_api_cost_actual_live
views.definition:
SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (usage_date = CURRENT_DATE) THEN cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS actual_cost_today_eur,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (usage_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 6)) THEN cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS actual_cost_last_7d_eur,
    round(COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (usage_date >= (date_trunc('month'::text, now()))::date) THEN cost_eur
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric), 4) AS actual_cost_month_to_date_eur
   FROM api_cost_actual_daily;

views.name: v_api_cost_estimated_vs_actual_daily
views.definition:
WITH estimated AS (
         SELECT (api_usage_events.created_at)::date AS usage_date,
            api_usage_events.provider,
            round(sum(api_usage_events.estimated_cost_eur), 6) AS estimated_cost_eur
           FROM api_usage_events
          GROUP BY ((api_usage_events.created_at)::date), api_usage_events.provider
        ), actual AS (
         SELECT api_cost_actual_daily.usage_date,
            api_cost_actual_daily.provider,
            round(sum(api_cost_actual_daily.cost_eur), 6) AS actual_cost_eur
           FROM api_cost_actual_daily
          GROUP BY api_cost_actual_daily.usage_date, api_cost_actual_daily.provider
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(e.usage_date, a.usage_date) AS usage_date,
    COALESCE(e.provider, a.provider) AS provider,
    (COALESCE(e.estimated_cost_eur, (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,6) AS estimated_cost_eur,
    (COALESCE(a.actual_cost_eur, (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,6) AS actual_cost_eur,
    ((COALESCE(e.estimated_cost_eur, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(a.actual_cost_eur, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(16,6) AS delta_eur
   FROM (estimated e
     FULL JOIN actual a ON (((a.usage_date = e.usage_date) AND (a.provider = e.provider))));

views.name: km_vergleich
views.definition:
SELECT imei,
    ((erfasst AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'::text))::date AS tag,
    count(*) AS punkte,
    round((max(obd_km) - min(obd_km)), 1) AS obd_km,
    round((max(gps_zaehler_km) - min(gps_zaehler_km)), 2) AS gps_zaehler_km,
    round((sum(strecke_m) / (1000)::numeric), 2) AS eigene_km,
    min(erfasst) AS von,
    max(erfasst) AS bis
   FROM km_messung
  GROUP BY imei, (((erfasst AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'::text))::date);
